t: You're on Stanhope Street, in the London Borough of Camden. General Charles FitzRoy, the first Baron Southampton, died on this street in 1797. He was a soldier, politician and courtier. He joined the Foot Guards as an ensign in 1752 and fought at the Battle of Minden in 1759 as an aide-de-camp, where he was caught up in the controversy over Lord George Sackville's slow reaction to orders. He also fought at Vellinghausen, and sat in the Commons from 1759 to 1780.
